snippet.title: VEIL - Official Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436490/VEIL

Graewolv proudly presents this first-ever early gameplay from VEIL, an upcoming co-op tactical horror FPS. VEIL is coming to PC and is available to Wishlist on Steam.

In VEIL, you play as Warlocks that form Occult Operator Teams to carry out missions for the warring factions in the city of Velumgrad. To even the odds against numerous and powerful enemies you make demonic pacts that grant you supernatural powers. VEIL is a co-op game for up to four players.

Follow VEIL on social media:
https://veilthegame.com 
X : https://twitter.com/veil_the_game
Discord : https://discord.gg/7JxqcDZ9Pq
TikTok : https://www.tiktok.com/@veil_the_game
